diagnosis: Ciliary body melanocytoma transforming to uveal melanoma
legend: H&E section showing a ciliary body melanocytoma (on the left) transforming to a uveal melanoma (on the right). Note the loss of pigment and the higher N:C ratio of the uveal melanoma cells.
An unbleached section shows heavily melanized, polygonal melanocytic cells that are artefactually separated. Their nuclei are central to peripheral.
FNAC shows a cluster of ovoid cells with centrally located small nuclei and intracytoplasmic pigment (Pap stain).
source:
EYE5 - Laver NS
